■ Synopsis:
Sadao has an unparalleled fondness for middle-aged women.

Today, too, on my way home from school, I let my imagination run wild, fantasizing about the middle-aged women working in the shopping district.

Mika, a helper at the daycare center, let me try changing a diaper, and in the process, she noticed I had an erection...

Miyuki, a widowed part-timer at a bookstore, gets scolded for trying to secretly buy an erotic magazine, and in the process, her love for big breasts is revealed...

Lisa, a photographer at a photo studio, becomes a model for a camera test, but her braless, large breasts excite him greatly...

Calligrapher Miharu-sensei, who runs a calligraphy class, was rumored to have given birth to her lover's child, and she took the rumor seriously and engaged in breastfeeding play...

English conversation instructor, Ms. Malaika, has an extraordinary body that captivated me, and when I confessed my feelings, we had sex on our first date!

...and so on, their unrealistic fantasies escalate.

Will Sadao finally be able to lose his virginity to a working mature woman this time?!
